overview_description.description:
Striga enables companies to embed compliant payment rails within their application without doing any of the heavy lifting related to MiCA licensing, EMI licensing etc. 

Made by developers, for developers, Striga is a set of powerful APIs to easily access compliant user onboarding, custody, trading, IBAN issuing and card issuing for 30+ countries in the European Union.
